items.title: 12.10 Dikhne wali kaainat ka zyada tar maadda plasma hai (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Hamari kaainat hamari soch se zyada wasee hai: hum is ke sirf taqreeban 5% hisse ko jaante hain aur baqi 95% ke baare mein ab bhi nahi jaante. Maslan hamari kaainat mein taqreeban 27% na-maloom maadda hai jise dark matter kehte hain aur taqreeban 68% pur-asrar antigravity cheez jise dark energy kehte hain. 27% aur 68% jama karne se 95% banta hai: hum kaainat ke 95% ke baare mein kuch nahi jaante.

Doosri taraf kaainat ka jo 5% hum jaante hain, yaani aam maadda, us ka mass ke lehaz se taqreeban 74-75% hydrogen, taqreeban 24% helium aur sirf 1-2% bhaari elements hain, aur hydrogen aur helium taqreeban poori tarah plasma halat mein hain. Is se kitab nateeja nikalti hai ke dikhne wali kaainat ke 5% ka 95% plasma halat mein hai, jabke baqi 5% maadde ki shakal mein; lihaza dikhne wali kaainat ka zyada tar maadda plasma hai, kyunke sitare, jin mein zyada tar dikhne wala maadda hai, garam ionized gas se bane hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai ke maloom 5% mein 68% hydrogen, 27% helium aur 5% aam maadda hai. Yeh 68%, 27% aur 5% to poori kaainat mein dark energy, dark matter aur aam maadde ke hisse hain jo ghalti se dobara likh diye gaye; aam maadda khud apna hissa nahi ho sakta. Sahi: aam maadda taqreeban 74-75% hydrogen, 24% helium aur 1-2% bhaari elements hai (kitab ka apna topic 12.9 72% hydrogen aur 24% helium deta hai).

blocks.caption: Kitab ki kaainat ki tasveer
rows: taqreeban 5%; zyada tar plasma halat mein hydrogen aur helium

blocks.prompt: Dikhne wali kaainat ke zyada tar maadde ko plasma kyun kaha ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar dikhne wala maadda sitaron aur sitaron aur galaxies ke darmiyan garam gas mein hai. Un ki hydrogen aur helium itni garam hai ke un ke atoms azaad electrons aur nuclei mein ionize ho jate hain, jo plasma halat hai; Zameen jaise aam solids, liquids aur neutral gases bohat chhota hissa hain.

items: Kaainat ka taqreeban 95% na-maloom hai: dark matter (taqreeban 27%) aur dark energy (taqreeban 68%). Maloom 5% mein hydrogen aur helium taqreeban sab ionized plasma hain, to dikhne wala zyada tar maadda plasma hai.
